site.tagline: RNG and ACE tools for FireRed and LeafGreen

home.description: RNG, Pokémon creator, code checker and guides for FireRed and LeafGreen on Nintendo Switch. Everything runs in your browser.

rng.title: FireRed and LeafGreen RNG on Switch
rng.description: Pick a seed, find the shiny, nature or IVs you want and time it with the site's own timer. Statics, wild encounters, Tanoby Unown and eggs.

editor.title: Pokémon editor (pk3)
editor.description: Open .pk3 files, create or tweak a Gen 3 Pokémon (species, nature, IVs, EVs, moves, shiny), check that it is legal and see how to get it into your game.

codes.title: Community codes (ACE)
codes.description: Paste the box names of a community ACE code and check everything before typing it in the game, with the cursor path letter by letter.

guides.title: Guides
guides.description: Step by step for ACE through the Mail glitch, the Base64 writer, the SID and the ESP32 board on Switch FireRed, without risking your save.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.description: What changed in each version of the site, from newest to oldest, with the highlights of each one.

notfound.title: Page not found
